content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to get NMR data to infer methyl groups. Likely we need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). Then analyze peaks: look for signals around 0.9 ppm (alkyl methyl) maybe integration. The tool returns a string with peaks and integration? Not sure format. We'll call proton_nmr_spectra.
